main_text.l: stet Monarchiæ; in qua, sens-
us, consilium, suprema vero in Va-rios, velut sensus, ...
stet Monarchiæ; in qua, spargi potest in Va-rios, velut sensus, consilium, suprema vero in Vno tantum ut in Capite, Potestas.
Forte, olim Horrores expertis & Malignas [?]
Influentias ex hac meâ Obtenebratione &
Eclipsi ( interpositâ videlicet illius Corporis
umbrâ, quod à me solum ut Lunæ Lucem
suam mutuatur ) gratior erit restituti sui Solis
Gloria ; & in pretio majore fœlicitas.
In præsentia, si hâc Juris mei diminutione
in exercendâ Militia minus videar fidè Meam,
& Juramentum tueri, quod in Populi defen-
sionem suscperam, eorum culpa est (opinor
qui mihi hanc necessitatem fecerunt, nova qua-
dam & præpostera ratione fidem meam libe-
randi, dum sic videar Fidei commissa deferre,
atque ita solum conservandi subditos meos,
ut in pacem eorum, & quietem, me pericu-
lo autinfamiæ objiciam.
Id enim, in Bello Civili, prævalente Parte
una, aliter effici non potest, nisi cedat altera;
quod tamen ut faciam, plus in me valet Amor
Publici, & firma Auxilii Divini fiducia, (quæ
è Bona Conscientia fluit) quam quæ unquam
sperari possunt ab eorum Timoribus, qui (cum
ex facinorum suorum Improbitate quantum-
vis prospera oriantur,) nunquam aliàs eos sec-
uros præstabunt, quam Militia & Gladio mu-
nitos, quæ tamen infirma admodum sunt mu-
nimina adversus Iræ Divinæ & Conscientiæ suæ
flagella, quorum hæc, semper nefariè admissa
comitantur, illa olim proculdubio deprehen-
dent.

page.notes: Printed text is in roman type with italic words as marked; the italic word at the start of the second paragraph, read as "Malignas", is doubtful. The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page; the opening paragraph is marked cont="true". The running head is set partly in Greek letters with Latin letters mixed in ("EIKΩN BAΣIAIKH"); transcribed as printed. "Vno" in the first paragraph has a possible abbreviation mark over the n that may not be fully legible. The parenthesis after "est" in the third paragraph is open in print and is kept as printed.
